```html
<script>
(function(){
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const phone = $('phone');
  const S = {account:'',bank:'',amount:0,pw:'',checked:false,accountError:false,bankError:false,amountError:false,busy:false};
  const BALANCE = 1000000;
  let current='start', tab='bank', ready=false, lists=null;
  let pending=null, cancelFocus=null, dataTimer=null;
  window.__log=[];
  window.__screen=()=>current;
  window.__dump=()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__log));
  const fmt=n=>Number(n).toLocaleString('ko-KR');

  function record(type,extra){
    window.__log.push(Object.assign({type:type},extra||{}));
  }
  function show(name){
    init();
    current=name;
    phone.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('on',s.dataset.screen===name));
    $('cancel-layer').hidden=true;
    render();
    if(name==='bank-picker') filterBanks();
    record('screen_enter',{to:name});
    const content=phone.querySelector('.screen.on .content');
    if(content) content.scrollTop=0;
  }
  function reset(){
    if(pending) clearTimeout(pending);
    pending=null;
    Object.assign(S,{account:'',bank:'',amount:0,pw:'',checked:false,accountError:false,bankError:false,amountError:false,busy:false});
    $('recipient-memo').value='';
    $('my-memo').value='';
    $('bank-search').value='';
    tab='bank';
    render();
  }
  window.__startTask=function(){
    init();
    window.__log.length=0;
    reset();
    record('task_start');
    show('start');
  };

  function koreanName(name){
    const names={
      BNP:'비엔피',BOA:'비오에이',HSBC:'에이치에스비씨',
      JP:'제이피',SC:'에스씨',BNK:'비엔케이',DB:'디비',
      IBK:'아이비케이',KB:'케이비',NH:'엔에이치',LS:'엘에스'
    };
    const letters={
      A:'에이',B:'비',C:'씨',D:'디',E:'이',F:'에프',G:'지',
      H:'에이치',I:'아이',J:'제이',K:'케이',L:'엘',M:'엠',
      N:'엔',O:'오',P:'피',Q:'큐',R:'알',S:'에스',T:'티',
      U:'유',V:'브이',W:'더블유',X:'엑스',Y:'와이',Z:'지'
    };
    return String(name).replace(/BNP|BOA|HSBC|BNK|IBK|JP|SC|DB|KB|NH|LS/g,m=>names[m])
      .replace(/[A-Za-z]/g,m=>letters[m.toUpperCase()]);
  }
  function koreanAmount(n){
    if(!n) return '';
    const digits=['','일','이','삼','사','오','육','칠','팔','구'];
    function group(x){
      let out='';
      const units=['','십','백','천'];
      for(let i=3;i>=0;i--){
        const d=Math.floor(x/Math.pow(10,i))%10;
        if(d) out+=(d===1&&i>0?'':digits[d])+units[i];
      }
      return out;
    }
    const upper=Math.floor(n/10000),lower=n%10000;
    return (upper?group(upper)+'만':'')+(upper&&lower?' ':'')+group(lower)+' 원';
  }

  function render(){
    if($('acc-input').value!==S.account) $('acc-input').value=S.account;
    $('acc-input').classList.toggle('invalid',S.accountError);
    $('acc-input').setAttribute('aria-invalid',String(S.accountError));
    $('acc-error').hidden=!S.accountError;
    $('acc-error').textContent=S.accountError?'계좌번호를 확인할 수 없습니다. 받는 사람의 계좌번호를 다시 확인해 주세요':'';
    $('fix-account').hidden=!S.accountError;
    $('acc-note').textContent=S.account.length>=14?'계좌번호는 최대 14자리까지 넣을 수 있습니다.':S.account&&!S.checked?'입력한 계좌를 다시 확인해 주세요.':'';
    $('picked-bank').textContent=S.bank?koreanName(S.bank)+' · 은행 변경하기':'은행 선택하기';
    $('picked-bank').classList.toggle('invalid',S.bankError);
    $('bank-error').hidden=!S.bankError;
    $('bank-error').textContent=S.bankError?'이 계좌번호와 은행이 맞지 않습니다. 받는 사람의 은행을 다시 선택해 주세요':'';
    $('fix-bank').hidden=!S.bankError;
    const accountHasError=S.accountError||S.bankError;
    $('acc-reason').textContent=accountHasError?'':!S.account?'계좌번호를 입력해 주세요':!S.bank?'은행을 선택해 주세요':'';
    $('acc-next').hidden=accountHasError;
    $('acc-next').disabled=!S.account||!S.bank||accountHasError;
    $('amt-recipient').textContent=koreanName(S.bank)+' '+S.account;
    $('amt-display').textContent=S.amount?fmt(S.amount)+'원':'금액을 넣어 주세요';
    $('amt-reading').textContent=koreanAmount(S.amount);
    $('amt-error').hidden=!S.amountError;
    $('amt-error').textContent=S.amountError?'보낼 수 있는 금액을 넘었습니다. 보낼 수 있는 금액은 1,000,000원입니다. 이전 금액을 유지했습니다.':'';
    $('amt-reason').textContent=S.amount?'':'보낼 금액을 1원 이상 넣어 주세요';
    $('amt-next').disabled=!S.amount;
    $('rv-bank').textContent=koreanName(S.bank);
    $('rv-account').textContent=S.account;
    $('rv-amount').textContent=fmt(S.amount)+'원';
    $('pw-dots').querySelectorAll('.dot').forEach((d,i)=>d.classList.toggle('filled',i<S.pw.length));
    $('pw-count').textContent='4자리 중 '+S.pw.length+'자리 입력';
    $('send-final').textContent=S.busy?'보내는 중입니다':fmt(S.amount)+'원 보내기';
    $('send-final').disabled=S.pw.length!==4||S.busy;
    $('send-status').textContent=S.busy?'보내는 중입니다':S.pw.length<4?'비밀번호 4자리를 입력해 주세요':'금액을 확인하고 보내기를 눌러 주세요.';
    $('dn-amt').textContent=fmt(S.amount);
    $('dn-bank').textContent=koreanName(S.bank);
    $('dn-account').textContent=S.account;
    phone.querySelectorAll('#verify button').forEach(b=>{
      if(b.id!=='send-final') b.disabled=S.busy;
    });
  }
  function invalidate(){
    S.checked=false;
    S.accountError=false;
    S.bankError=false;
    S.pw='';
  }
  function checkAccount(){
    S.accountError=false;
    S.bankError=false;
    if(S.account!=='110234567890'){
      S.checked=false;
      S.accountError=true;
      record('error',{id:'wrong-account'});
    }else if(S.bank!=='신한'){
      S.checked=false;
      S.bankError=true;
      record('error',{id:'wrong-bank'});
    }else{
      S.checked=true;
      show('transfer-amount');
      return;
    }
    render();
    const field=S.accountError?$('acc-error'):$('bank-error');
    field.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
  }
  function setAmount(next){
    if(next>BALANCE){
      S.amountError=true;
      record('error',{id:'amount-over-balance'});
    }else if(Number.isFinite(next)&&next>=0){
      S.amount=next;
      S.amountError=false;
      S.pw='';
    }
    render();
  }
  function addButton(parent,action,value,text,cls){
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.type='button';
    b.dataset.action=action;
    if(value!==null) b.dataset.v=String(value);
    b.textContent=text;
    if(cls) b.className=cls;
    parent.appendChild(b);
    return b;
  }
  function buildPw(){
    if(!ready) return;
    const keys=lists.PW_KEYS.slice();
    for(let i=keys.length-1;i>0;i--){
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      [keys[i],keys[j]]=[keys[j],keys[i]];
    }
    $('pwpad').replaceChildren();
    keys.forEach(v=>addButton($('pwpad'),'pw',v,String(v)));
    addButton($('pwpad'),'pw-shuffle',null,'숫자 위치 바꾸기','small');
    addButton($('pwpad'),'pw-del',null,'한 자리 지우기','small');
  }
  function filterBanks(){
    const q=$('bank-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    let count=0;
    phone.querySelectorAll('.bank-choice').forEach(b=>{
      const matches=!q||b.dataset.bank.toLowerCase().includes(q)||koreanName(b.dataset.bank).includes(q);
      b.hidden=!matches||(!q&&b.dataset.group!==tab);
      if(!b.hidden) count++;
      const selected=b.dataset.bank===S.bank;
      b.classList.toggle('selected',selected);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected));
      b.textContent=koreanName(b.dataset.bank)+(selected?' · 선택됨':'');
    });
    $('tab-bank').classList.toggle('active',tab==='bank');
    $('tab-sec').classList.toggle('active',tab==='sec');
    $('tab-bank').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(tab==='bank'));
    $('tab-sec').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(tab==='sec'));
    $('bank-result').textContent=count?(q?'은행과 증권사 전체에서 '+count+'곳을 찾았습니다.':'이름을 눌러 선택해 주세요.'):'찾는 이름이 없습니다. 검색어를 바꿔 주세요.';
    const content=phone.querySelector('[data-screen="bank-picker"] .content');
    content.scrollTop=0;
  }
  function openBank(){
    init();
    $('bank-search').value='';
    tab='bank';
    show('bank-picker');
  }

  function init(){
    if(ready) return true;
    if(!window.PRESERVED) return false;

    const BANKS=window.PRESERVED.BANKS;
    const SECS=window.PRESERVED.SECS;
    const AMT_KEYS=window.PRESERVED.AMT_KEYS;
    const ACC_KEYS=window.PRESERVED.ACC_KEYS;
    const PW_KEYS=window.PRESERVED.PW_KEYS;
    const QUICK=window.PRESERVED.QUICK;

    if(![BANKS,SECS,AMT_KEYS,ACC_KEYS,PW_KEYS,QUICK].every(v=>Array.isArray(v)&&v.length>0)) return false;

    lists={BANKS,SECS,AMT_KEYS,ACC_KEYS,PW_KEYS,QUICK};
    $('acc-pad').replaceChildren();
    ACC_KEYS.forEach(v=>addButton($('acc-pad'),'acc-num',v,String(v)));
    addButton($('acc-pad'),'acc-del',null,'한 자리 지우기','wide');

    $('amt-pad').replaceChildren();
    AMT_KEYS.forEach(v=>addButton($('amt-pad'),'num',v,String(v)));
    addButton($('amt-pad'),'del',null,'한 자리 지우기','small');

    $('amt-quick').replaceChildren();
    QUICK.forEach(v=>{
      const label=String(v)==='all'?'전액':koreanAmount(Number(v)).replace(' 원','원')+' 더하기';
      addButton($('amt-quick'),'quick',v,label);
    });

    $('bank-list').replaceChildren();
    BANKS.forEach(name=>{
      const b=addButton($('bank-list'),'pick-bank',name,koreanName(name),'bank-choice');
      b.dataset.bank=String(name);
      b.dataset.group='bank';
    });
    SECS.forEach(name=>{
      const b=addButton($('bank-list'),'pick-bank',name,koreanName(name),'bank-choice');
      b.dataset.bank=String(name);
      b.dataset.group='sec';
    });

    ready=true;
    buildPw();
    filterBanks();
    render();
    if(dataTimer!==null){
      clearInterval(dataTimer);
      dataTimer=null;
    }
    return true;
  }

  $('acc-input').addEventListener('input',function(){
    S.account=this.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,14);
    invalidate();
    render();
  });
  $('bank-search').addEventListener('input',filterBanks);

  phone.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    const el=e.target.closest('[data-action]');
    if(!el||!phone.contains(el)||el.disabled) return;
    const a = el.dataset.action;
    init();
    record('tap',{action:a,screen:current});
    if(S.busy) return;
    if(!$('cancel-layer').hidden&&!['continue-input','stop-transfer'].includes(a)) return;

    if(a==='go-recipient'){
      reset();show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='previous'){
      if(current==='recipient-details') show('start');
      else if(current==='transfer-amount') show('recipient-details');
      else if(current==='review') show('transfer-amount');
      else if(current==='verify') show('review');
    } else if(a==='cancel'){
      cancelFocus=el;
      $('cancel-layer').hidden=false;
      phone.querySelector('[data-action="continue-input"]').focus();
    } else if(a==='continue-input'){
      $('cancel-layer').hidden=true;
      if(cancelFocus) cancelFocus.focus();
    } else if(a==='stop-transfer'){
      reset();show('start');
    } else if(a==='acc-clear'){
      S.account='';invalidate();render();$('acc-input').focus();
    } else if(a==='acc-del'){
      S.account=S.account.slice(0,-1);invalidate();render();
    } else if(a==='acc-num'){
      if(S.account.length<14){S.account+=el.dataset.v;invalidate();}
      render();
      $('acc-input').scrollLeft=$('acc-input').scrollWidth;
    } else if(a==='focus-account'){
      $('acc-input').focus();
    } else if(a==='fix-account'){
      $('acc-input').focus();
      $('acc-input').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
    } else if(a==='open-bank'){
      openBank();
    } else if(a==='fix-bank'){
      openBank();
    } else if(a==='close-bank'){
      show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='focus-search'){
      $('bank-search').focus();
    } else if(a==='tab-bank'){
      tab='bank';filterBanks();
    } else if(a==='tab-sec'){
      tab='sec';filterBanks();
    } else if(a==='pick-bank'){
      S.bank=el.dataset.bank;invalidate();show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='account-next'){
      if(S.account&&S.bank) checkAccount();
    } else if(a==='num'){
      setAmount(Number(String(S.amount)+el.dataset.v));
    } else if(a==='del'){
      setAmount(Math.floor(S.amount/10));
    } else if(a==='quick'){
      setAmount(el.dataset.v==='all'?BALANCE:S.amount+Number(el.dataset.v));
    } else if(a==='amount-next'){
      if(S.amount&&S.checked) show('review');
      else if(!S.checked) show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='edit-account'){
      show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='edit-amount'){
      show('transfer-amount');
    } else if(a==='focus-recipient-memo'){
      $('recipient-memo').focus();
    } else if(a==='focus-my-memo'){
      $('my-memo').focus();
    } else if(a==='go-verify'){
      if(!S.checked){show('recipient-details');return;}
      buildPw();show('verify');
    } else if(a==='pw'){
      if(S.pw.length<4) S.pw+=el.dataset.v;
      render();
    } else if(a==='pw-del'){
      S.pw=S.pw.slice(0,-1);render();
    } else if(a==='pw-shuffle'){
      buildPw();render();
    } else if(a==='send-final'){
      if(S.pw.length!==4||!S.checked||!S.amount) return;
      S.busy=true;render();
      record('submit',{bank:S.bank,account:S.account,amount:S.amount});
      pending=setTimeout(function(){
        pending=null;S.busy=false;S.pw='';
        show('complete');record('task_end');
      },450);
    } else if(a==='finish'){
      reset();show('start');
    }
  });

  if(!init()) dataTimer=setInterval(init,50);
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',init,{once:true});
  render();
  record('screen_enter',{to:'start'});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
